summary: Added three capabilities (material barrel entry-point split reading the installed exports map and .d.ts surfaces; util call-site expansion with single-evaluation templates and %s-directive format rewriting; diagnostic-driven RxJS prototype-patch to pipe with installed-surface verification) plus 43 tests covering positives and refusals. Drove the staged lane over two application rounds and four builds: 72 diagnostics/29 unresolvable specifiers down to 4/0, deterministic across two consecutive runs, 25 application files changed with digests, util@^0.12.5 declared via consented install. Build stays red on four newly surfaced families (service-worker deep import, entryComponents, ModuleWithProviders, FileReader.result); each itemized in u17c-green-lane.json. No artifacts, so parity remains null. tsc, lint and 1567 node tests green.
